metadata.ripgrep:
ripgrep 15.2.0 (rev e89fff89ac)

features:+pcre2
simd(compile):+NEON
simd(runtime):+NEON

PCRE2 10.45 is available (JIT is available)

scope: Fresh process for every sample; no application cache, no source hashes, no persistent index. OS page cache is uncontrolled and may be warm. macOS purge was denied in the preceding startup run. Rotate five configurations; keep every first sample, no retries.
limits: Single macOS machine and synthetic short texts; not physical-cold disk.
Literal mode is the direct retrieval comparison. BM25 is separately reported and does more work than rg literal.
Default rg and explicit 1/4-thread settings are all shown; conclusions must include tuned baselines.
Process RSS is one separate maximum, not a stable memory distribution.
Cross-target score tolerance covers libc/libm differences; order, paths and strings must match exactly.
